viewing_check: Check the Pascall tin's hinge and hasp, how much of the lid picture survives (it looks heavily worn in the photo), and the rust spot on the base. Count the small tins and look for any with intact lids and bright printing, since most look worn or rusty. I found no outside sale of an Old Oak tin; the comparables are other Pascall tins (A$10 to A$195) and mixed tobacco tin lots (Burns & Co selections A$30 to A$50 hammer in Mar 2026; eBay lots of 10 to 20 rusty tins A$54 to A$75).
